children: Mumbai: HDFC Bank deputy managing director Kaizad Bharucha has sought to step down from the lender effective December 31, 2026, weeks after the RBI approved Anup Bagchi to succeed Sashidhar Jagdishan as managing director and chief executive.

Bharucha, one of HDFC Bank's longest-serving executives and a founding member, was one of the two candidates whose names the bank had submitted to the RBI for the top job. However, his candidature faced a tenure constraint under the central bank's rules, which cap an individual's continuous tenure as a managing director, chief executive or whole-time director at 15 years. The bank's board accepted his request and will forward it to the RBI for approval.

title: HDFC Bank Dy MD Bharucha Quits, Weeks After CEO Pick
